ℹ️  No dividend activity found for the calendar year: this Activity Statement has neither a 'Dividends' nor a 'Change in Dividend Accruals' section (IBKR omits both when there were none), so the 'Total gross amount paid/credited...' column is set to 0 for every holding. Wrote Schedule FA Table A2 (foreign custodial account) 1 row(s) to <tmp>/out/schedule-fa-a2.csv
  ⚠️  Fill these Table A2 portal cell(s) before filing — left blank because they could not be computed with certainty:
    - Peak Balance During the Period
    - Closing balance
      The closing balance is blank because the statement has no Net Asset Value section, or that section has no asset-class table with a 'Current Total' column.
      Re-export the Activity Statement from IBKR with its Net Asset Value section and re-run. Otherwise, enter it by hand in the review CSV or XLSX, or in the portal: the account's Net Asset Value on 31 December of the requested calendar year, in its base currency, converted to INR at that date's SBI TTBR.
     Find your account's HIGHEST total native-currency value (securities + cash) on any single day of the calendar year, then convert it to INR at that peak date's SBI TTBR. Per Rule 114F a custodial account's value INCLUDES the cash held in it, not just the securities — and the statement carries no daily account NAV, so the peak day cannot be derived.
  ℹ️  Table A2 (the account) and Table A3 (the holdings inside it) deliberately overlap — do NOT add A2's balance to the A3 holding values when testing the Black Money Act ₹20-lakh threshold; that double-counts the same assets. Consult your CA.
